headline: 3 days after wedding: Newlywed man killed in road accident in Noakhali
summary: Md Al-Amin, 28, died after his motorcycle collided head-on with a battery-run auto-rickshaw in Senbagh.
details: A 28-year-old man, Md Al-Amin, was killed in a road accident in Senbagh upazila of Noakhali on Thursday night.
The accident occurred around 9:30 pm in the Kutirbari area along the Senbagh-Sonaimuri road when Al-Amin's motorcycle collided head-on with a battery-run auto-rickshaw carrying poultry.
Al-Amin was critically injured and rushed to the Senbagh Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared him dead.
Family members revealed that Al-Amin had married in an arranged ceremony on July 20, just three days before the accident.

Police are currently preparing to file a case at the request of the victim's family.
caption:
Married just three days ago, a young man's life was cut short in a tragic head-on collision in Noakhali.

A 28-year-old man, Md Al-Amin, was killed in a road accident in Senbagh upazila of Noakhali on Thursday night.

The accident occurred around 9:30 pm in the Kutirbari area along the Senbagh-Sonaimuri road when Al-Amin's motorcycle collided head-on with a battery-run auto-rickshaw carrying poultry.

Al-Amin was critically injured and rushed to the Senbagh Upazila Health Complex, where doctors declared him dead.

Family members revealed that Al-Amin had married in an arranged ceremony on July 20, just three days before the accident.

The deceased ran a pharmacy business at Chhatarpaiya Bazar alongside his father and brother.

Officer-in-Charge of Senbagh Police Station Abdur Rahim Sarkar confirmed the incident and stated that police have visited the scene.

Police are currently preparing to file a case at the request of the victim's family.

headline_marked: 13th night in a row: [[US strikes Iran]] to weaken military capacity
headline: 13th night in a row: US strikes Iran to weaken military capacity
summary: US Central Command reports targeting military command centers and drone depots to secure the Strait of Hormuz.
details: The United States has carried out military strikes in Iran for the 13th consecutive night. According to US Central Command (CENTCOM), the operations aim to weaken Iran's military capabilities and ensure the safety of commercial ships and civilian vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
caption:
13 consecutive nights of strikes. The US has hit Iranian military targets for nearly two weeks straight.

The United States has carried out military strikes in Iran for the 13th consecutive night. According to US Central Command (CENTCOM), the operations aim to weaken Iran's military capabilities and ensure the safety of commercial ships and civilian vessels in the Strait of Hormuz.
